notes.title: Weapon modification system
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=cmsj39z5IoU;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Weapon Modification System[/b]: We are working on improving this system, aiming to enhance the interactivity and functionality of weapon variability in the game. This might include various types of enhancements, such as changes in appearance, increased power, and altered weapon characteristics, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840540/ff6767165c044fefc921ccce5e22c2d887005e26.jpg[/img]

[b]Character Clothing System[/b]: We have added a clothing system that enriches the visual and gameplay experience, allowing players to personalize their characters. This might include diverse costumes, armor, accessories, which may also impact the character's attributes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840540/5149f40b1116b7e73df4ba3cb0348d7f465fa29f.jpg[/img]

[b]Inventory System Overhaul[/b]: We have improved the inventory system, aiming for simplification and optimization in inventory management, making it more intuitive and user-friendly. This includes an enhanced interface, better item organization, and more efficient ways of sorting and accessing items.

[b]Demo Version of the Game[/b]: We plan to include all these mechanics and improvements in the demo version of the game, which will give potential players the opportunity to familiarize themselves with the new features and participate in feedback for further improvement.

These improvements are aimed at increasing player engagement and satisfaction, offering broader possibilities for customization and interaction in the game world.

notes.title: HOLD YOUR BREATH - Gameplay Stream
notes.notes:
Welcome to the survival world of "HOLD YOUR BREATH"!

Hello, dear friends and survival game enthusiasts!

🌪 We're embarking on a thrilling journey into a world teetering on the brink of ecological catastrophe, where every breath could be your last, and every decision is a matter of survival.

🎮 In this demo version, we invite you to immerse yourself in the game's atmosphere, get acquainted with the core mechanics, and of course, experience the spirit of adventure and survival in a world where every action you take matters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840540/e69238f705afb2fba60f2b974855d5ede1871b38.png[/img]

💡What Awaits You in "HOLD YOUR BREATH"?

- Explore a vast open world, filled with dangers, mysteries, and challenges.
- Battle for every breath of clean air, devising strategies to extract, purify, and conserve oxygen.
- Craft weapons and armor to protect yourself from threats like wild animals and bandits.
- Adapt to a changing, harsh world where the rules shift as swiftly as the weather.
- Interact with other survivors, uncovering new narrative branches and unraveling the apocalypse's mysteries.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840540/6170ba6589f8259102b2aa1a64cde4552a288665.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840540/c06eff3142a59176ef273aacfebfc8f54cc48906.png[/img]

Join Us at "Next Fest"!
We await you on October 14th at 11:00 AM PDT / 10:00 AM PST!

Dive into the world of "HOLD YOUR BREATH", explore, survive, and remember: every breath is precious...

#HoldYourBreathGame #NextFest #Steam #IndieGame #SurvivalGame

notes.title: New demo version - 0.93.28
notes.notes:
New demo version - 0.93.28
Problems with completing the initial quest have been fixed.
The interface, weapon setup, and surfing have been corrected.
The world map has been fixed and new regions and areas for exploration have been added.
An enemy and several types of weapons that you will find on the map have been added.
The version has been optimized for Steam Deck.
Gamepad support has been improved.
Game saving has been added, currently only to one slot.

The nearest update for the next version is scheduled for October 13th.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840540/e69238f705afb2fba60f2b974855d5ede1871b38.png[/img]

Sincerely, Animpic Studio.

notes.title: Demo Launch
notes.notes:
September 27th, we plan to provide access to everyone interested to try out the demo version of our game. Please note that this version includes only a portion of the gameplay and mechanics, so we kindly ask you not to judge us harshly. Currently, we are working diligently on the game and continuously updating the demo to gather your feedback regarding various gameplay decisions.
